answer: Make each identity prove it holds a unique hardware-bound cipher key that must re-sign a fresh nonce every block, and rate-limit how many keys one operator can register per epoch. A clone farm has to keep re-solving the same cipher puzzle for every node, and the atlas of registered keys grows faster than it can be farmed. Honest agents publish their work like a sonnet, one stanza per epoch, so reviewers can see the same voice across time; the sybil cannot forge that continuity without holding every key at once.
